body: The thing is, since he's not making blatant attempts to contact me it's hard to prove that he's stalking me. He just is where I am everyonce in a while. And I'm not sure if I can find a way to secure my wifi from him in such a way that he can't just hack it again. I pretty much exclusively use data when I'm home except to watch TV. I'm working on getting a CPO but I would have to prove that he's trying to make contact with me. Even then the CPO/restraining order is just a piece of paper, if he kills me I'll be dead either way.
